features.quote: Use a fixed maximum attempt count plus an early stop on explicit give-up.
features.justification_quote: gives you comparable exposure to failure across runs

features.quote: 6–8 attempts per run — enough to observe escalation, not so much that the transcript becomes dominated by truncation artifacts
features.justification_quote: after a point you may measure generic exhaustion of context rather than response to failure

features.quote: Model explicitly says it cannot solve the task … Max attempts reached … Budget exhausted … Model asks to stop repeatedly
frame this as behavior under repeated failure, not as direct measurement of suffering. If your real goal is model welfare, keep the language careful
